claims.statement: For abelian K over ℚ containing the required roots, one r bounds |Cl(K(μ_{ℓⁿ}))/ℓCl(K(μ_{ℓⁿ}))| by ℓ^r for all n. The window assembly uses a proved witness FW.ferreroWashington.

claims.title: Uniformity in the varying two-primary base
claims.statement: For each fixed abelian datum M of degree b there is a bound R₂=4(g+6b), where g is chosen over M(i) before q,d. Both the N=1 and N=2 tower modules over base2(M,q,d) have at most R₂ generators. For a fixed odd-prime datum A one can take max(1,r).
claims.hypotheses: Prime q≡3 mod 8, prime d≡7 mod 16, gcd(qd,M.m)=1. At an odd ℓ the datum A contains the requisite roots. All realizations of each field datum are admitted.

claims.statement: On a field in the tower, restriction identifies Sha¹(F,ℚℓ/ℤℓ(−e)) with the equivariant characters of the infinite cyclotomic kernel, unramified everywhere and trivial on decomposition groups above ℓ.
claims.hypotheses: e is a nonzero integer. The cyclotomic image is procyclic under the roots hypothesis, including μ₄ at 2. Ramification is allowed in the prescribed set over ℓ and places above those primes are fixed.

claims.title: The sign and power in the layer cokernel
claims.statement: For e≠0 and a degree-ℓ^m cyclotomic layer, the locally trivial degree-one length equals the cokernel length of (χ(γ)^e x₀(γ))^(ℓ^m)−1. Degrees and twists refer to a common tower generator. At the reference layer its length is bounded by the full H² with twist e+1 using finite-level Poitou–Tate and local inputs.
claims.hypotheses: Arithmetic generator chosen from a base with HasMuQ. Total complexity gives the PTCase required at ℓ=2 for the later degree-two comparison. No finite-length assumption is needed for the equality.
